rationale.mapping_notes: Tokens are the core palette copied verbatim per variant, with --gradient built from the core's three monotonic stops as a 135-degree linear-gradient. Type tokens carry the core's three voices: Grenze for display (angular roman-blackletter hybrid, suits a game about inscription and inheritance without tipping into costume), Crimson Pro for body (a plain book serif that holds a long paragraph, replacing the source artefact's Iowan Old Style default) and JetBrains Mono for labels and tabular figures. Shape tokens come from the core unchanged; the 3px small radius matches the source artefact's own restrained corner treatment. Google Fonts lists only the two webfonts: the mono fallback stack is adequate on its own and is left unloaded to keep the payload down.

type.--font-body: 'Crimson Pro', 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, Georgia, serif

html.theme_switch: data-theme attribute on :root plus prefers-color-scheme fallback (see artefact-conventions)
